recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not reintroduce Citation or ArtifactUrlClassifier source for FHIR-33421; if Citation is maintained by another project in the future, reconcile that external source separately using the 2021 applied commits as implementation history.
issue_request: FHIR-33421 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 CDS change request for FHIR-core Citation. It requested replacing Citation.citedArtifact.webLocation.type and ArticleUrlType with 0..* Citation.citedArtifact.webLocation.classifier bound to ArtifactUrlClassifier, with final resolution modifications for extensible binding strength and the version-specific/Version Specific terminology.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in source/citation by Jira-tagged commits: a90e9fc0ed renamed ArticleUrlType to ArtifactUrlClassifier, 78054d153f aligned the ArtifactUrlClassifier terms, cac6497938 changed Citation.citedArtifact.webLocation.type to classifier with max * and extensible binding, and 078498975f updated Citation examples from type to classifier.
additional_context: The current branch no longer contains source/citation. Commit 71567db3ee removed Citation and structuredefinition-Citation.xml from core, the active [resources] section in source/fhir.ini has no Citation entry, and the only current artifact-url-classifier hits in core source are OID registrations. A read-only Extension Pack search found no authoritative Citation webLocation classifier source replacement.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The required reconciliation is an empty audit because the historical R5 change was applied and the affected artifact is now outside the current core build.

related_jiras.note: A later ResearchStudy webLocation.type to classifier change surfaced in git history, but it affects a different resource and was not decided here.
